final_action.public_message: Boardwalk rent paid. Still hunting bank lots before I deal color. Your move.

Don't mortgage. Don't trade Vermont to p4 — that hands them light blue. They won't sell Oriental+Connecticut cheap, and buying that set drains the cash I need to land and build pink/orange. Utilities and railroads don't finish a color. End and hunt Virginia first, then remaining oranges.
